XenotypeDef.label: slorg
XenotypeDef.description:
The Slorg are a cybernetic collective. Each drone is a human body bolted full of implants, run through with nanoprobes, and wired to a neural transceiver that links it to every other drone. They don't negotiate or trade, and they don't breed. They grow by assimilating others.

A drone alone is weak. Inside the collective, each drone can use everything the others know.

Drones only exist in the Slorg faction. A drone that joins you becomes a disconnected drone.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Cybernetic hive-mind drones who grow their collective by assimilating others. Every drone shares the skills and strength of the whole.

XenotypeDef.label: slorg queen
XenotypeDef.description: The queen is the voice of the Slorg collective, an individual grown to speak for the whole. She rarely leaves the Unicomplex and only comes to the field with the largest assaults.\n\nKill or capture her and the drones around her are severed from the collective. The collective will raise another queen, but only destroying the queen core in the Unicomplex ends their hold on this world.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: The voice and will of the Slorg collective. Her fall severs the drones around her.

XenotypeDef.label: slorg thrall
XenotypeDef.description: Someone the nanoprobes finished with before the collective could take them to a maturation chamber. A thrall has no implants and no exoplating, and still looks like the person they were. But the collective link is in their brainstem and nanoprobes run in their blood, and they serve the collective completely.\n\nA thrall shares the collective's knowledge and can inject others. Free one and they lose the Slorg genes, keeping only a dead transceiver.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Half-assimilated: linked to the collective and full of nanoprobes, but without the cybernetics of a full drone.

XenotypeDef.label: disconnected drone
XenotypeDef.description: A former Slorg drone whose link to the collective has been cut, whether by surgery, the fall of their queen core, or by joining another faction. They keep any implants they had and their nanoprobes, but they are individuals again, slowly relearning how to be alone in their own head.\n\nSlorg nanoprobes destroy any genetic material taken from them, and their genes can't be passed on to children.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Former Slorg drones cut off from the collective. They keep their implants, but they are individuals again.
